item.title: Single-Family-Owned 2001 Ford F-150 SVT Lightning
item.description: This 2001 Ford F-150 SVT Lightning is one of 6,381 produced for the model year and spent time with a single family up through the seller's ownership in 2006. Now indicating 24k miles the truck is finished in Bright Red over Medium Graphite cloth and Ebony leather, and it powered by a supercharged 5.4-liter V8 linked with a four-speed automatic transmission and a limited-slip differential. item.title: 7k-Mile 1980 Porsche 928 5-Speed
item.description: This 1980 Porsche 928 remained under the care of two previous owners before the seller's purchase in 2013, and it now shows 7k miles. Finished in Black Metallic over beige leather upholstery. it powered by a 4.5-liter V8, and shifting is through a five-speed manual transaxle that was rebuilt in 2025.
